Practised taking-away stories within 9.

end.parentNote: Kabir practised taking-away stories within 9 using spoken examples and answers. They worked through several examples, including 9 − 4 = 5 and noticing that nothing remains when everything goes away. There was a mix-up about subtraction order; the idea that 3 − 5 can equal 2 was not corrected by the end. At home, use small objects to act out “take away” stories and ask which number comes first.
